headline: disabling prefetch still leaves 9 of 9 repeats non-bit-identical, so the prefetch hypothesis is refuted; four of five hypotheses are now refuted by measurement
gap_found: I only tested all-reduce in R210 and never tested all-to-all, yet USP with --usp 4 relies on all-to-all; also untested is reduce-scatter
next_step: test all-to-all and reduce-scatter determinism, about a minute with no weights
bonus_finding: legacy runs at 26.923 s per warm step versus native at about 20.0 s, so prefetch does deliver roughly 6.9 s per step of performance even though it is not the non-determinism cause
